name: Chronicle
summary: A slow camera over a surface (map, document, timeline) that stamps dates, pushes into a detail and dissolves to mark time passing. For history, biography and anything told as what happened in what order.

visual_job.viewer_leaves_able_to: Place the events in order, in place and in time, and say what led to what.
visual_job.hero: A surface the camera moves over: map, document or timeline.

use_when: Places and dates carry the meaning.
Primary documents, maps or photographs exist or can be honestly recreated.
avoid_when: The film is about one person's inner arc (use storybook).
The past is only a backdrop for a technical or financial argument.

alternates.when: Recent history where sepia would feel false.

scene_grammar.formula: Date and place stamped on a surface with the first image already visible.
A map or establishing document, framed so the place is readable.
The timeline advances; each event is date stamp, place mark, one-line fact.
Slow push into the document or photograph detail that mattered.
Before and after on the same surface.
Numbers and human cost, set with restraint.
Pull back to the whole surface with the date range and source.

motion.signature: A camera over a surface: push into a detail, pull back to the whole, dissolve to mark time passing.
motion.continuous_layer: Slow push or pan on the surface with grain boil, so a held document is never a held frame.
avoid: Modern UI elements on period material.
Generated period imagery that is not labelled as generated.

rules.ending: Pull back to the whole surface with the date range and source; hold the bed, no ramp to silence.

anti_patterns.pattern: Narration over a frame that does not change for more than max_beat_gap_sec.
anti_patterns.why: Breaks the anti-laziness rule. motion-qa flagged 41 s of 70 (cloud), 44 s of 92 (fridge), 79 s of 98 (Korea) as static or low-energy. Plan one visual event per 2-3 s from measured onsets and give every scene a drift layer (Studio.space.drift).

anti_patterns.pattern: Ramping the bed to zero over the last seconds.
anti_patterns.why: Cloud's last moment measured 19 LU under the body. Land a soft thud and ring on the last visual event, hold the bed, keep the tail after the last word to 2-3 s.

anti_patterns.pattern: The same empty stage in most scenes.
anti_patterns.why: repeat-layout-dom fired in all three films (3-5 of 6 scenes). A recurring grid is fine when its state changes; vary the hero's position or scale between scenes.

anti_patterns.pattern: Generated or recreated period imagery presented as archive.
anti_patterns.why: The design profile requires licensed or generated imagery to be labelled as such.

anti_patterns.pattern: Named or shown things the viewer cannot read an explanation of (anonymous chips, a badge with no field, a term with no definition).
anti_patterns.why: game-theory-trust closed on a ranked column of unlabelled chips and the words 'the simplest entry'; the owner's review called it a knowledge gap that leaves the viewer uncomfortable. Where narration cannot afford the explanation, the visuals carry it: definition card, legend, rule written out, source line. See motion-graphics-designer section G.

reference_projects.note: History and storytelling; 105 s portrait on editorial-light.
Collage treatment of a dated event.

open_questions: The archival style system has never been used in a rendered project (its own validation record says so). The first render decides whether it holds.

revisions.change: Initial version. Rules from the archival-historical profile (5 s shots, slow dissolves) and the documentary narration budget.

Added the anti-pattern 'named or shown things the viewer cannot read an explanation of': the visuals carry the information the narration skips (motion-graphics-designer section G). No other rule changed.
